goblin.name: Goblin
traits: Nimble Escape: The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
actions: Scimitar: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) slashing damage.
Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

wolf.name: Wolf
traits: Keen Hearing and Smell: The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
actions: Shortsword: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.
Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

orc.name: Orc
traits: Aggressive: As a bonus action, the orc can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.
actions: Greataxe: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12+3) slashing damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

zombie.name: Zombie
traits: Undead Fortitude: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
actions: Slam: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage.

bandit.name: Bandit
actions: Scimitar: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) slashing damage.
Light Crossbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8+1) piercing damage.

kobold.name: Kobold
traits: Sunlight Sensitivity: While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Pack Tactics: The kobold has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Dagger: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.
Sling: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) bludgeoning damage.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
traits: Keen Smell: The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pack Tactics: The rat has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) piercing damage.

black_bear.name: Black Bear
traits: Keen Smell: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Multiattack: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.
Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

ogre.name: Ogre
actions: Greatclub: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+4) bludgeoning damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6+4) piercing damage.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.immunities: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
traits: Shadow Stealth: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
actions: Strength Drain: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
traits: Turning Defiance: The ghoul and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.
actions: Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) slashing damage. If the target is a creature other than an elf or undead, it must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
traits: Spider Climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
Web Sense: While in contact with a web, the spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
Web Walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or take 9 (2d8) poison damage. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned and unconscious for 1 hour.

Web (Recharge 5-6): The spider shoots a web at a creature within range. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be restrained for as long as the web lasts and until the creature breaks free. The web has AC 10, 5 hit points, resistance to bludgeoning damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.

harpy.name: Harpy
traits: Multiattack: The harpy makes two attacks: one with its claws and one with its shortbow.

Luring Song: The harpy sings a magical melody. Each humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the harpy that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The harpy must take its action to continue singing. The song ends if the harpy is incapacitated. While charmed by the harpy, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other harpies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target must move toward the harpy by the most direct available route, using its full movement on each of its turns, unless the target is harmed or threatened by the harpy or some other creature, or prevented from moving by some magical effect.
actions: Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4+2) slashing damage.
Shortbow: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing damage.

mimic.name: Mimic
traits: Shapechanger: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

Adhesive (Object Form Only): The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic is also grappled by it (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have disadvantage.
False Appearance (Object Form Only): While the mimic remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary object.
Keen Smell: The mimic has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
actions: Pseudopod: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target is subjected to its Adhesive trait.
Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
traits: Labyrinthine Recall: The minotaur can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

Reckless: At the start of its turn, the minotaur can decide to gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.
actions: Multiattack: The minotaur makes two melee attacks: one with its greataxe and one with its hooves.
Greataxe: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d12+4) slashing damage.
Hooves: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) bludgeoning damage.

Charge: If the minotaur moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. After making this charge attack, the minotaur can use its bonus action to make one hooves attack against the prone target.

bugbear.name: Bugbear
traits: Brute: A melee weapon deals one extra die of its damage when the bugbear hits with it (included in the attack).
Long-Limbed: The bugbear's reach is 5 feet greater than normal for melee and ranged weapon attacks.
Powerful Build: The bugbear counts as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push or drag.
Surprise Attack: If the bugbear surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 2d6 damage from the attack.
actions: Morningstar: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8+2) piercing damage.
Javelin: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage.

chimera.name: Chimera
traits: Multiattack: The chimera makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. When half or fewer of its hit points remain, it also regains use of its fire breath on its turn.
actions: Bite: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+5) piercing damage.
Claws: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8+6) slashing damage.

Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6): The chimera exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (14d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
fireball.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4+1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously.
magic_missile.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the spell creates one more dart for each slot level above 1st.

cure_wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure_wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
cure_wounds.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

mage_armor.name: Mage Armor
mage_armor.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
mage_armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

shield.name: Shield
shield.casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you are hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell
shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile.

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

sacred_flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred_flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

bless.name: Bless
bless.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)
bless.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can add a d4 to the attack roll or saving throw.

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
burning_hands.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

misty_step.name: Misty Step
misty_step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
healing_word.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.

spiritual_weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual_weapon.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
spiritual_weapon.at_higher_levels: The damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of several harmless sensory effects: a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. You clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. You warm, cool, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. You make a small, solid object appear or vanish in your hand (no more than 1 cubic foot in size). You color, or recolor, an object no larger than 1 cubic foot for 1 hour.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of several harmless sensory effects: a flare of pale flame that flickers, a ghostly trumpet sound, a rumbling in the earth, or faint otherworldly choir. You cause your eyes to glow dimly for 1 minute. You cause a door to fly open or slam shut. You amplify your voice so it carries clearly for up to 300 feet.

minor_illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor_illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. If you create an image of an object, it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or temperature. The image is a static visual representation; it can't move.

vicious_mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious_mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

spare_the_dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare_the_dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. Additionally, unsecured objects that are completely within the spell's area are pushed 10 feet away from you by the spell's wave, and the spell exerts a loud thunderous sound that can be heard 300 feet away.
thunderwave.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

charm_person.name: Charm Person
charm_person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and it does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.
charm_person.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

detect_magic.name: Detect Magic
detect_magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its school of magic, if any. The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

fog_cloud.name: Fog Cloud
fog_cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of at least 10 miles per hour dispels it.
fog_cloud.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.components: V, S, M (a small silver mirror)
sanctuary.description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded creature from area effects, such as the explosion of a fireball. If the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this spell ends.

guiding_bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding_bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until the end of your next turn.
guiding_bolt.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
hold_person.description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
hold_person.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.components: V, M (a snake's tongue and either a bit of bee honey, an oil drop, or a drop of sweet water)
suggestion.description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the spell. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity is completed, the spell ends.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, staying out of your way so they can't be attacked directly. Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell's duration, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates. If you have three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target to a duplicate. With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher. With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher. A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)
shatter.description: A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw. Inanimate objects in the spell's area are also dealt 3d8 thunder damage, automatically failing the saving throw.
shatter.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

lesser_restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser_restoration.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned.

haste.name: Haste
haste.components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)
haste.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action. When the spell ends, the target can't move or take actions until after its next turn, as a wave of lethargy washes over it.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell
counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.
counterspell.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the interrupted spell has no effect if its level is less than or equal to the level of the spell slot you used.

dispel_magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel_magic.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the spell ends.
dispel_magic.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you automatically end one spell on the target if its level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you used.

fear.name: Fear
fear.components: V, S, M (a white feather or the heart of a hen)
fear.description: You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration. A frightened creature must use its movement to move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends for that creature.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a crystal rod)
lightning_bolt.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
lightning_bolt.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

animate_dead.name: Animate Dead
animate_dead.components: V, S, M (a piece of bone, a piece of flesh, or a bit of grave dirt)
animate_dead.description: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse (the DM has the creature's game statistics). On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. If you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one. You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until the task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends.
animate_dead.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell with a 4th-level spell slot, the target becomes a wight instead of a zombie or skeleton. When you cast this spell with a 5th-level spell slot, you can animate two targets, and with a 6th-level spell slot, three targets, and with a 7th-level spell slot, four targets. The targets must be within 10 feet of each other when you target them.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a different form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs. The target assumes the hit points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, it returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed. If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious. You can transform the target into a beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's level (or CR, if it doesn't have a level).

banishment.name: Banishment
banishment.components: V, S, M (a holy symbol or unholy symbol)
banishment.description: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished. If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane. While there, the target is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target is banished with a flash and a pop, returning to its home plane. Otherwise, the target is banished to a harmless demiplane.
banishment.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.

greater_invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater_invisibility.description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

hold_monster.name: Hold Monster
hold_monster.components: V, S, M (a small, straight iron bar)
hold_monster.description: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. This spell has no effect on undead. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
hold_monster.at_higher_levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

scrying.name: Scrying
scrying.components: V, S, M (an ornate silver mirror worth at least 1,000 gp)
scrying.description: You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. For a lesser known target, the save is made with advantage. For a familiar or intimate connection (such as a family member or sworn ally), the save is made with disadvantage. If the target is on a different plane of existence, the save is made with disadvantage. On a failed save, the target has no choice about being seen or heard; you perceive through the target's senses. On a successful save, the spell has no effect.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up. The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against the creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet; otherwise disadvantage.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.description: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0. The condition ends if the grappler is incapacitated, or if the creature is removed from the grappler's reach.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

fighter.name: Fighter
level_1_features: Fighting Style: Choose a fighting style specialty.
Second Wind: On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.

wizard.name: Wizard
level_1_features: Spellcasting: You can cast wizard spells using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability.
Arcane Recovery: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up).

rogue.name: Rogue
level_1_features: Expertise: Choose two of your skill proficiencies; your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks using them.
Sneak Attack: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage to a creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage, or another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it.
Thieves' Cant: You know this secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code.

cleric.name: Cleric
level_1_features: Spellcasting: You can cast cleric spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.
Divine Domain: Choose a domain related to your deity, granting domain spells and features.

human.name: Human
traits: Versatile: humans have no single defining trait - just a well-rounded aptitude across every ability.

elf.name: Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.

halfling.name: Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

high_elf.name: High Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.
Elf Weapon Training: you have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
Cantrip: you know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.
Extra Language: you can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Keen Senses: you have proficiency in the Perception skill.
Fey Ancestry: you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
Trance: elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply for 4 hours a day.
Elf Weapon Training: you have proficiency with the longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.
Fleet of Foot: your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.
Mask of the Wild: you can attempt to hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

hill_dwarf.name: Hill Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.
Dwarven Toughness: your hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again every time you gain a level.

mountain_dwarf.name: Mountain Dwarf
traits: Darkvision: you can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
Dwarven Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.
Stonecunning: whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient and add double your proficiency bonus.
Dwarven Armor Training: you have proficiency with light and medium armor.

lightfoot_halfling.name: Lightfoot Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
Naturally Stealthy: you can attempt to hide even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

stout_halfling.name: Stout Halfling
traits: Lucky: when you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.
Brave: you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Halfling Nimbleness: you can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.
Stout Resilience: you have advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

potion_of_healing.name: Potion of Healing
potion_of_healing.description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

candle.name: Candle
candle.description: Sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius for 1 hour.

climbers_kit.name: Climber's Kit
climbers_kit.description: Grants advantage on climbing checks when used.

component_pouch.name: Component Pouch
component_pouch.description: A pouch of small pockets for spell components with somatic/material requirements.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: Advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

healers_kit.name: Healer's Kit
healers_kit.description: 10 uses; stabilizes a dying creature without a roll.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A spellcasting focus for a cleric.

holy_water.name: Holy Water
holy_water.description: Deals 2d6 radiant damage to a fiend or undead if thrown and shattered on it.

hooded_lantern.name: Hooded Lantern
hooded_lantern.description: Bright light in a 30-foot radius, burns 1 pint of oil per 6 hours.

hunting_trap.name: Hunting Trap
hunting_trap.description: A creature stepping on it takes 1d4 piercing damage and its speed becomes 0.

manacles.name: Manacles
manacles.description: DC 20 Dexterity check or DC 20 Strength check to escape without the key.

oil.name: Oil
oil.description: A one-pint flask; can be thrown as a splash weapon or burned as fuel.

pouch.name: Pouch
pouch.description: Holds up to 1/5 cubic foot or 6 lb. of material.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.description: 100 blank pages for recording spells; a wizard's spellcasting focus and spell repository.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.description: Objects viewed through it are magnified to twice their size.

tinderbox.name: Tinderbox
tinderbox.description: Used to light torches, candles, campfires, etc.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: Sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius for 1 hour.

acid.name: Acid
acid.description: A vial; as an action, can be thrown up to 20 feet for 2d6 acid damage.

alchemists_fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
alchemists_fire.description: A flask; thrown for 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of the target's turns until put out.

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.description: A vial; grants advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

ball_bearings.name: Ball Bearings
ball_bearings.description: A bag of 1,000; covers a 10-foot square in difficult, slippery terrain.

caltrops.name: Caltrops
caltrops.description: A bag of 20; a creature entering the area takes 1 piercing damage and its speed is halved.

burglars_pack.name: Burglar's Pack
burglars_pack.description: Backpack, bag of 1,000 ball bearings, 10 feet of string, bell, 5 candles, crowbar, hammer, 10 pitons, hooded lantern, 2 flasks of oil, 5 days rations, tinderbox, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

diplomats_pack.name: Diplomat's Pack
diplomats_pack.description: Chest, 2 cases for maps/scrolls, fine clothes, ink, ink pen, lamp, 2 flasks of oil, 5 sheets of paper, vial of perfume, sealing wax, soap.

dungeoneers_pack.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
dungeoneers_pack.description: Backpack, crowbar, hammer, 10 pitons, 10 torches, tinderbox, 10 days rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

entertainers_pack.name: Entertainer's Pack
entertainers_pack.description: Backpack, bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, 5 days rations, waterskin, disguise kit.

explorers_pack.name: Explorer's Pack
explorers_pack.description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days rations, waterskin, 50 feet of hempen rope.

priests_pack.name: Priest's Pack
priests_pack.description: Backpack, blanket, 10 candles, tinderbox, alms box, 2 blocks of incense, censer, vestments, 2 days rations, waterskin.

scholars_pack.name: Scholar's Pack
scholars_pack.description: Backpack, book of lore, ink, ink pen, 10 sheets of parchment, small bag of sand, small knife.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: Proficiency grants bonuses to picking locks and disarming traps.

herbalism_kit.name: Herbalism Kit
herbalism_kit.description: Used to identify/apply herbs; needed to craft potions of healing and antitoxin.

disguise_kit.name: Disguise Kit
disguise_kit.description: Grants bonuses to convincingly alter your appearance.

forgery_kit.name: Forgery Kit
forgery_kit.description: Used to forge a document or seal.

navigators_tools.name: Navigator's Tools
navigators_tools.description: Used to chart a course and navigate by the stars.

poisoners_kit.name: Poisoner's Kit
poisoners_kit.description: Used to create and apply poisons.

potion_of_climbing.name: Potion of Climbing
potion_of_climbing.description: You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour, and advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

bag_of_holding.name: Bag of Holding
bag_of_holding.description: Holds up to 500 lb., not exceeding 64 cubic feet, in an extradimensional space; weighs 15 lb. regardless of contents.

cloak_of_protection.name: Cloak of Protection
cloak_of_protection.description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn (requires attunement).

driftglobe.name: Driftglobe
driftglobe.description: A glass orb that can float and shed light on command (requires attunement).

immovable_rod.name: Immovable Rod
immovable_rod.description: A button locks the rod in place in midair or against a surface; it can hold up to 8,000 lb.

ring_of_protection.name: Ring of Protection
ring_of_protection.description: +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while worn (requires attunement).

rope_of_climbing.name: Rope of Climbing
rope_of_climbing.description: A 60-foot silk rope that animates on command to knot, unknot, or climb on its own.

wand_of_magic_missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
wand_of_magic_missiles.description: While holding this wand, you can use an action to cast the magic missile spell from it (requires attunement).

+1_weapon.name: +1 Weapon
+1_weapon.description: A weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

+1_armor.name: +1 Armor
+1_armor.description: Armor granting a +1 bonus to AC while worn.
